Text.Text: My clan has a reason to consider returning to the den. Go run with your beast; you've both earned safer ground. You've finished my Primal Overrun trials. I have no further work for you here.
Reach rank 50 in Beast Mastery before you enter these trials. It's your training as a handler I need to trust. The den punishes careless handling.

Handlers took my clan's den and turned its beasts into weapons. Recover their trail slate so we can begin undoing that work. Defeat six Primal Overrun Adepts in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Primal Overrun Grotto Track Slate; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing. I'll give you the Dathomir Grotto Apex Den Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Primal Overrun.

Here's the Dathomir Grotto Apex Den Key. Use 'Enter the Grotto Apex Den' in Dathomir, Grotto Caverns. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Primal Overrun Adepts, then return with the Primal Overrun Grotto Track Slate.

The den was ours before the handlers came in from off-world with their goad-sticks and their contracts. They did not want the beasts tamed, just broken and pointed. We fought for it once and lost good hunters to beasts that had stopped being beasts. I do not go back in for pride. I go in when the den asks for a debt paid, and right now it is asking through you.

Every clan hunter that ever ran that den left a mark on a slate like that: where the good trails run, where the ground lies to you. The adepts use it to route beasts onto killing floors instead of hunting ground. Bring it back whole and it goes back to reading trails instead of routing slaughter.

Adepts, mostly. Loud, proud, and sloppy with beasts that do not trust them yet. That works against them as much as for you; a beast driven wrong turns on its own handler as easy as you. Watch the ground, not just the fight.
Defeat six Primal Overrun Adepts in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Primal Overrun Grotto Track Slate; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
You've defeated six Primal Overrun Adepts. Let me see the Primal Overrun Grotto Track Slate.
That's the record I needed. We can account for the trails again. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists keep driving beasts past the warnings from their fang charm. Bring that charm back. Defeat five Primal Overrun Specialists in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Primal Overrun Resonant Fang Charm; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Defeat five Primal Overrun Specialists to secure the Primal Overrun Resonant Fang Charm, then return to me.

Adepts still flinch. Specialists trained the flinch out of themselves and their beasts both. They have turned Primal Overrun into something you do to an animal, not with one. A charge that is not chosen is not a charge, it is a shove. I want that shove stopped before it becomes a habit that outlives the den.

The resonant fang charm hums when a beast is about to break its bond and just run wild: old clan trick, to know the difference between fear and fury before it is too late to matter. The specialists wear it just to feel that hum and keep pushing anyway. Cruelty with a warning bell they ignore on purpose.

Because the last time I went into that den my own beast did not come out, and I put down what came out instead of him. I can send you. I cannot send myself back through that gate yet. Maybe not ever. That is mine to carry, not yours to fix.
Defeat five Primal Overrun Specialists in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Primal Overrun Resonant Fang Charm; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
You've defeated five Primal Overrun Specialists. Let me see the Primal Overrun Resonant Fang Charm.
This belongs with the handlers who know how to use it. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden trained those handlers to break beasts instead of bond with them. Defeat him and recover the apex totem. Defeat the Primal Overrun Warden in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Primal Overrun Cracked Apex Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Primal Overrun Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Primal Overrun Cracked Apex Totem.

One of ours, once. Best hand with a beast I ever trained besides myself. The handlers did not break him; they paid him, and he decided the shove worked better than the bond. He is the reason the specialists shove instead of ask. Cut that off at the root.

The cracked apex totem used to mark a den's true alpha trail, back when the den had one worth marking. He carries it broken because he broke it himself, on purpose, the day he stopped being clan. Bring it back whole enough to read and I will know the trail again.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Primal Overrun Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Primal Overrun Warden in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Primal Overrun Cracked Apex Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Primal Overrun Warden. Let me see the Primal Overrun Cracked Apex Totem.
The totem is back in our keeping. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four keepers still run the den's training. Take back the den-mother's token and end their orders. Defeat four members of the Primal Overrun Inner Circle in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Primal Overrun Den-Mother's Fang Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Defeat four members of the Primal Overrun Inner Circle to secure the Primal Overrun Den-Mother's Fang Token, then return to me.

They run the den now that the warden has gone quiet. Four voices deciding which beasts get shoved next, which trails get burned into killing floors. They learned cruelty as doctrine, and they teach it like doctrine: patient, repeatable, wrong.

Every den worth the name has a den-mother somewhere back in its bones, the first beast the clan ever bonded true, not broken. Her fang token was passed hunter to hunter as proof you knew the difference. The inner circle split it four ways so no one hunter could ever claim it again. Whole in your hand, it is proof the difference still means something.

Nothing like what they teach. A proper overrun is your beast choosing the same target you already chose, same breath, same moment, not a beast driven at something because a stick told it to. You will know it when it happens with yours. It feels like agreement, not a shove.

Defeat four members of the Primal Overrun Inner Circle in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Primal Overrun Den-Mother's Fang Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
You've defeated four members of the Primal Overrun Inner Circle. Let me see the Primal Overrun Den-Mother's Fang Token.
The keepers can no longer claim authority here. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master wrote the cruel methods the others follow. Defeat him in the Sealed Apex Den to finish the hunt. Defeat the Primal Overrun Master in Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Primal Overrun Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

The others copied pieces of the overrun. He never lost the whole of it; he just aimed it at cruelty instead of company. What you have been chasing this whole trial, the true version, the one your own beast is starting to feel with you, he still has. That is what makes him dangerous. That is also what you are about to take from him.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Primal Overrun Master fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

It goes back to being a den instead of a lesson in cruelty. Whether my clan ever walks back in, I do not know yet. That part is mine to decide, after. Yours is just to make sure there is a den left worth deciding about.

Defeat the Primal Overrun Master in Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Primal Overrun Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
My clan has a reason to consider returning to the den. Go run with your beast; you've both earned safer ground. You've earned the right to train Primal Overrun. Your final payment is ready.
Back to it.
I'll defeat six Primal Overrun Adepts.
What happened to your clan's den?
What's this track slate to you?
What am I walking into down there?
Not today. I need to think.
Here's the Primal Overrun Grotto Track Slate.
Back to it.
I'll defeat five Primal Overrun Specialists.
What makes a specialist worse than an adept?
What's the fang charm for?
Why can't you go in yourself?
Give me time first.
Here's the Primal Overrun Resonant Fang Charm.
Back to it.
I'll defeat the Primal Overrun Warden.
Who is this warden to you?
What's the apex totem?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Not until I've got my two.
Here's the Primal Overrun Cracked Apex Totem.
Back to it.
I'll defeat four members of the Primal Overrun Inner Circle.
What do the inner circle actually do?
What's the den-mother's fang token?
What does a proper overrun feel like?
My company needs rest first.
Here's the Primal Overrun Den-Mother's Fang Token.
Back to it.
I'll face the Primal Overrun Master and report back.
What makes him different from the warden and the circle?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What happens to the den, after?
Not until my company's ready.
The Primal Overrun Master is defeated. Here's my report.
